title: Leader Election
text: Welcome to this system design series tutorial. Today, we're diving into the world of leader election algorithms for distributed systems. Distributed systems are a core part of modern computing, and understanding how to manage them as essential. Let's get started with leader election. So what exactly is leader election? In a distributed system, leader election is the process by which multiple nodes coordinate to select a single node to act as the leader

text: . This leader then takes on the responsibility of coordinating tasks, making decisions, or managing resources across the system. Think of it as a democratic process, but for computers. Now, the question is, why do we even need leader election and distributed systems? There are two key reasons. Firstly, to avoid split-brain scenarios. This is when multiple nodes incorrectly believe they are the leader, leading to conflicting decisions and data corruption. Secondly, to achieve coordination
